description: This file contains functions and classes for resolving secret references from various sources (environment variables, files, external commands), including error handling, security checks, and concurrency management within a secret management system.

classes.name: SecretProviderResolutionError
classes.description: Error class for issues during secret provider resolution.

classes.name: SecretRefResolutionError
classes.description: Error class for issues during secret reference resolution.

methods.name: isProviderScopedSecretResolutionError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a SecretProviderResolutionError.

methods.name: providerResolutionError
methods.description: Creates a new SecretProviderResolutionError.

methods.name: refResolutionError
methods.description: Creates a new SecretRefResolutionError.

methods.name: throwUnknownProviderResolutionError
methods.description: Throws an error if the provided error is not a known secret resolution error.

methods.name: readFileStatOrThrow
methods.description: Reads file stats and throws if the file is not accessible or not a file.

methods.name: isAbsolutePathname
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute, including Windows-specific patterns.

methods.name: resolveResolutionLimits
methods.description: Resolves limits for secret resolution based on configuration.

methods.name: toProviderKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a provider based on source and provider name.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredProvider
methods.description: Resolves provider configuration, throwing if not configured properly.

methods.name: assertSecurePath
methods.description: Verifies that a file path is secure and accessible according to security policies.

methods.name: readFileProviderPayload
methods.description: Reads and caches payloads from secret files, with security and timeout handling.

methods.name: resolveEnvRefs
methods.description: Resolves environment variable secret references, with allowlist checks.

methods.name: resolveFileRefs
methods.description: Resolves file-based secret references, parsing JSON or single values.

methods.name: runExecResolver
methods.description: Runs an external command to resolve secrets, with output and timeout management.

methods.name: parseExecValues
methods.description: Parses the output of an exec secret provider, validating protocol and response structure.

methods.name: resolveExecRefs
methods.description: Resolves secrets via external command execution, handling batching and security.

methods.name: resolveProviderRefs
methods.description: Dispatches secret resolution to the appropriate source handler.

methods.name: resolveSecretRefValues
methods.description: Resolves multiple secret references concurrently, respecting limits.

methods.name: resolveSecretRefValue
methods.description: Resolves a single secret reference, with caching.

methods.name: resolveSecretRefString
methods.description: Resolves a secret reference and ensures it is a non-empty string.
